item.title: Computational Linguistics Fall School 2026 — University of Technology Nuremberg (UTN)
item.description: Dates: 21 Sep – 2 Oct 2026 · 12 days. Location: University of Technology Nuremberg, Nuremberg, Germany. Deadline: 2026-09-06. Registration-fee scholarship for selected participants · otherwise EUR 150 students / EUR 200 non-students · Apply on official page. Topics: linguistics, computational linguistics, natural language processing, corpus linguistics
